reviews.decision_reason: map_coverage preserves all eight allowed handoff needs, assigns direct coverage only for exact capability/need matches, and leaves unsupported needs visible with empty capability_id.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: preserve exact handoff need records without unrelated candidates
avoid generic keyword matches when mapping capability coverage
keep unsupported or missing coverage visible

reviews.decision_reason: prioritize_needs ranks unsupported needs ahead of direct coverage and uses upstream provenance rank as the within-group ordering key, producing one priority row per covered need.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: rank unsupported demand gaps before covered needs
use provenance rank rather than repeated history as corroboration
preserve missing or unsupported evidence visibility

reviews.decision_reason: synthesize_recommendation keeps the bounded priority window and derives decision/top_need directly from the already-ranked first priority record, matching the deterministic recommendation requirement.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: construct recommendation from first ranked priority record
avoid adding new market-demand claims from background research
